method: Run the shipped name-only inventory query against the exact first natural failed state. Count positive itemStats.regen independently. No synthetic gear or played outcome is created.
finding: Search intentionally matches names only. Defense-effect words can return zero even when relevant owned armor exists; this is an opportunity for explicit effect filters, not a claim that the existing name-search implementation violates its contract.
proposal: An optional armor-effect filter for persistent recovery, opening ward, or reduction can expose actual candidates without an automatic best-item recommendation. Keep current owned-state comparison and post-survival recovery semantics.
